points.title: Intellectual property
points.must: Creations of the mind (inventions, software, texts, music, designs, logos) that the creator owns and has legal rights to control; not physical objects.

points.title: Copyright
points.must: Legal right of the author of an original work to control copying, distribution, changes and sale; automatic, no registration; life + 70 years.

points.title: Patent and trademark
points.must: Patent: registered right for an invention, about 20 years; trademark: registered name / logo / slogan of a company (™, ®).

points.title: Other protections
points.must: Industrial design (appearance of a product) and trade secret (kept confidential, NDAs), each with an example.

points.title: Which protection applies
points.must: A comparison table or diagram: what each protects, how it is obtained (automatic vs registered), an example of each.

points.title: Law in Kazakhstan
points.must: Law on Copyright and Related Rights protects programs and databases; Civil Code; serious infringement is a crime.

points.title: Software licence
points.must: Definition: a legal agreement stating how software may be used, copied, shared and changed.

points.title: Licence types
points.must: Proprietary, shareware / trial, freeware, open source, Creative Commons (BY, NC, ND, SA) — use, copy, source code, example.

points.title: Piracy, plagiarism, mis/disinformation
points.must: Definitions of piracy, plagiarism, misinformation (by mistake) and disinformation (deliberate).

points.title: Problems of disseminating information
points.must: At least five problems (piracy, plagiarism, infringement, fake news, personal data disclosure, defamation, harmful content, overload) and who is harmed.

points.title: Analysing piracy
points.must: Effects on the creator, the user (malware, no updates, fines) and society, plus prevention (licence keys, DRM, legal action, prices).

points.title: Analysing fake news and checking sources
points.must: Why it spreads and its harm; checks: source, other reliable sources, date, evidence.

points.title: Using information legally
points.must: Creative Commons images with credit, quotation marks and citations, licensed / open-source software, consent before posting about people; fair use exceptions.

points.title: Worked example
points.must: A scenario (e.g. school documentary) with the correct behaviour for music, photos and text.
